name: CSV Cleaner (trim, dedupe)
summary: Clean CSV files — trim fields, remove empty rows, and deduplicate records.
description: Paste messy CSV exports and clean them locally: trim whitespace, drop blank rows, and dedupe by full row or a key column before import.

faqs.question: How does dedupe work?
faqs.answer: By default entire rows are compared. Optionally set a key column like id or email.
